Officer's narrative
Driver 1 reported that while changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, the vehicle was sideswiped by a
sedan operated by Driver 2. Upon arrival, I observed both vehicles at rest on the shoulder and in the adjacent lane.
Driver 1 was present at the scene and was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, a fact confirmed by my
observations and by statements from the other parties present. Driver 1 stated experiencing pain to the left shoulder
following the impact and was evaluated on scene. The nature of the reported injury is consistent with the force and
direction of the contact described. Damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with a lateral
sideswipe, and I found no indication of prior damage to that area. Scene photographs taken by responding personnel
show several details of the collision, though no independent witnesses were identified who observed the impact.
Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy. Driver 2 was cooperative and provided insurance
information. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
